description: Lists the next three departures today from a place for each route and direction that boards there, soonest first, with the minutes until each, the last bus of the day, the fare and the stops each direction serves after the place. Routes with live bus positions give live times counted from where each bus is now.

city.description: City network from find_places or list_cities, such as Lahore, Attock or Rawalpindi.

name: place_departures
title: Next departures
